     reliability and quiet confidence in everyday life and work.
  2. Green
     Green is the colour of growing leaves, fresh grass and new beginnings, so it often feels restful and grounding. It
     sits in the middle of the visible spectrum, which makes it easy on the eyes, and many people associate it with
     health, balance, renewal and the natural world around them.
  3. Red
     Red is a bold, energetic colour that draws attention quickly and is associated with passion, warmth and strong
     emotion across many cultures. It appears in celebrations, signals and art, and people who favour it often enjoy its
     vivid presence and the sense of excitement it brings.
